rex duos filios Respha filie Ahia quos p: the two sons of Respha the daughter of Aia, whom she bore to Saul, Armoni, and Miphiboseth: and the five sons of Michol the daughter of Saul, whom she bore to Hadriel the son of Berzellai, that was of Molathi.
Secundum quoque fuit bellum in Gob: There was also a second battle in Gob
contra Philisteos. Tunc percussit Soboch: against the Philistines: then Sobochai of Husathi slew Saph
Tertium quoque fuit bellum in Gob contra: And there was a third battle in Gob against the Philistines, in which Adeodatus the son
Quartum bellum fuit in Geth in quo vir e: A fourth battle was in Geth, where there was a man of great stature, that had six fingers on his hands and feet, that is, four and twenty, and he was of the race of Arapha
Locutus est autem David Domino verba car: And David spoke to the Lord the words of this canticle, in the day that [the Lord] delivered him:
In tribulatione mea invocabo Dominum, et: In my distress I will call upon the Lord, and I will cry to my God: and he will hear out of his holy temple
concussa sunt et conquassata, quoniam ir: were moved, and shaken, because he was angry with them.
Ascendit fumus de naribus eius: A smoke went up from his nostrils
et ignis de ore eius voravit carbones su: and a devouring fire out of his mouth: coals were kindled by it.
Et ascendit super cherubin: And he rode upon the cherubims
et volavit et lapsus est super pennas ve: and flew: and slid upon the wings of the wind.
Tonabit de celo: The Lord shall thunder from heaven
Et apparuerunt effusiones maris et revel: And the overflowings of the sea appeared, and [the foundations of the world] were laid open
Liberavit me ab inimico meo potentissimo: He delivered me from my most mighty enemy,
Et eduxit me in latitudinem,: And he brought me forth into a large place,
Et cum electo electus eris et cum perver: With the elect thou wilt be elect: and with the perverse thou wilt be perverted.
In te enim curram accinctus. In Deo meo: For in thee I will run girded: in my God I will leap over the wall.
Persequar inimicos meos: I will pursue after my enemies
Inimicos meos dedisti mihi dorsum,: My enemies thou hast made to turn their back to me,
Salvabis me a contradictionibus populi m: Thou wilt save me from the contradictions of my people
filii alieni resistent mihi,: The sons of the stranger will resist me,
Qui educis me ab inimicis meis, et a res: Who bringest me forth from my enemies, and liftest me up from them that resist me: from the wicked man
Magnificans salutes regis sui, et facien: Giving great salvation to his king, and shewing mercy to his anointed
